A '''jacket''' or '''coat'''<ref name="Firepower">{{JournalCite|8|Firepower}}</ref> was an item of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] that was generally worn covering other layers of clothing such as [[shirt]]s.

Jackets could be made of materials such as [[Leather/Legends|leather]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] wore a leather jacket as part of his usual attire.<ref name="RPG" />
